title: Decentralized Consensus from Quantum Proof of Position
summary: We construct an energy efficient consensus protocol with geospatial position as an external resource by using quantum computers. Economic resources of some form are essential in decentralized consensus protocols in order to prevent attacks in which malicious parties costlessly generate fake identities. The resulting protocol, Quantum Proof of Position (QPoP), improves on existing classical mechanisms: it dispenses with the notorious electricity consumption of Proof-of-Work, and, because its resource is external to the protocol, with the wealth concentration of Proof-of-Stake.
